GBIF Biodiversity Data Gaps

Integrated Assessment: Spatial, Temporal, and Taxonomic Dimensions

gbifgaps

February 13, 2026

Executive Summary

This report presents a comprehensive assessment of biodiversity data gaps in the national GBIF occurrence database, integrating spatial, temporal, and taxonomic dimensions to inform strategic priorities for data collection and mobilization.

4.1 Key Findings

Summary of Data Gaps

Spatial Coverage: 89.9% of the country’s 10km grid cells have occurrence data.

Data Recency: 23.6% of cells have not been surveyed in over 5 years.

Taxonomic Coverage: 47.9% of backbone species have GBIF records.

Missing Threatened Species: 68 Critically Endangered and Endangered species lack GBIF records.

4.2 Priority Actions

Priority Category Action Target
High Spatial Survey zero-coverage grid cells 0 cells
